Gokuldham residents execute their plan to catch the car thief Peter. Boman uncle arrives with the stolen car, while Iyer poses as a wealthy buyer from Dubai over the phone. When Peter reaches the society to collect his money, the residents surround and beat him.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
